# Constitution — Pointer

**The authoritative constitution for this project is
[`specs/constitution.md`](../../specs/constitution.md) (v2.0.0).**

This file exists only because the Spec Kit tooling (`/speckit-plan`, `/speckit-specify`,
`/speckit-tasks`, `/speckit-analyze`, `/speckit-implement`) resolves the constitution from this
path at runtime.

## Do not edit this file

Per constitution rule **G.5**, two divergent constitutions MUST NOT exist in this repository.
Amendments go to `specs/constitution.md` through the process in its § Governance section.

## For agents and tooling

When a workflow instructs you to read the constitution, read `specs/constitution.md`.
Cite its rule identifiers (`ARC-002`, `REL-002`, `EDG-003`, …) directly in plans, specs, and
review comments.

| Document | Path |
|---|---|
| Architecture constitution (authoritative) | `specs/constitution.md` |
| Bounded context map | `specs/contexts.md` |
| Event schema & versioning governance | `specs/event-governance.md` |
| Code structure & developer workflow | `specs/guidelines.md` |
| Feature spec template | `specs/templates/feature-spec-template.md` |
